newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Council, Parliament agree on Raphael programme.
newsitem.headline: Council, Parliament agree on Raphael programme.

text.p: The European Union has agreed a 30-million-Ecu, four-year fund to protect its cultural heritage from museums and libraries to archeological sites and architecture, EU officials said.

The fund was approved after the Council and the European Parliament settled their differences over funding for the project, dubbed Raphael, at the second meeting of the conciliation committee on Wednesday.

The parliament had argued for almost three times more money for the project, on the grounds that the EU's citizens might better appreciate the bloc's more esoteric plans if they saw it protecting the cultural heritage they all enjoy.
But after Germany refused to earmark more money, the parliament agreed to accept what was on offer rather than lose the programme completely.
Both sides now have six weeks to formalise the programme.
